title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2018
ACT VII OF 2018
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC SERVICE
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 5th
March, 2018]
No.
PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills 151/ 2018 / 4829, dated
5.3.2018.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 19th February, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 28th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 7 of Ordinance No. XI of 1978

No.
PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills 151/ 2018 / 4829, dated
5.3.2018.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 19th February, 2018 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 28th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 7 of Ordinance No. XI of 1978.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), in section 7,-
(a) in
subsection (1),-
(i) in
clause (a), in sub-clause (ii), for the figures and word "11 to", the
figures and words "14 and" shall be substituted;
(ii) after
clause (a), the following shall be inserted, namely: "Explanation.---In
this clause, recruitment means initial appointment other than by promotion or
transfer.";
(iii) after
clause (b), the "Explanation" shall be deleted and the following new
clauses shall be added, namely:
"(c) to hold such other tests and examinations for promotion. selection
on merit or initial appointment as the case may be, for such posts as
Government may determine from time to time.
(d) to
act on any other matter which Government may refer to the Commission, from time
to time"; and
(b) in
subsection (2), in clause (iv), after the words "the posts of", the
words "Computer Operator, Assistant, Junior Scale Stenographer and
"shall be inserted.
